name: Chan ga cay
summary: Chân gà cay is a chicken-foot snack. The feet are soft and soaked in a sauce of chili, garlic, and onion, plus seasonings the article does not name.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, calls it a street snack.
taste: The article says the sauce is hot, with chili, garlic, and onion.
howToEat: Eat it as a snack, not as the lunch.
The rest of the sauce is not printed.
where: Hoi An. A street and the hour are Check on arrival.
